items.claim: Novonesis told the market it had carried out further transactions under its ongoing share buyback programme, in the weekly announcement filed under the designation 2026_20_Share_buyback.
items.source: Novonesis (Novozymes A/S) company announcement, no individual signatory named

items.claim: Novonesis offentliggjorde den 12. oktober en meddelelse om transaktioner under selskabets aktietilbagekøbsprogram, nummereret 2026_21 i serien, med selve opgørelsen henlagt til en vedhæftet PDF.

Novonesis meddelte den 15. oktober, at selskabet som officiel sponsor af Manufacturing Day 2026 har haft mere end 70 gymnasieelever på besøg på sine anlæg i Franklinton (NC), Blair (NE) og Salem (VA) mellem 30. september og 8. oktober.

Darren Alfano, Head of People and Organization for Novonesis North America, siger i meddelelsen: "You can't pursue a career you don't know exists", og at Manufacturing Day "gives students a chance to experience the innovative, world-class biomanufacturing happening right in their communities".
items.source: Darren Alfano, Head of People and Organization, Novonesis North America
